title: The Classic of Reversal — Fanjing / Changduanjing (English)
summary: An English reading of the Fanjing, properly the Changduanjing — the Classic of the Long and the Short — written by Zhao Rui of the Tang in 716. All nine scrolls and sixty-four chapters are covered: statecraft and the judging of men, the reversal of every instrument of government, a chronicle of the hegemons from the Zhou to the Sui, nineteen short essays on the perverse facts of the world, and twenty-four chapters on war. The colophon states exactly what this reading is and what was done to the text.
